Determine the common difference $d$ using the first term $a = 32$ and 5th term $u_5 = 22$:
$$u_5 = a + 4d \implies 22 = 32 + 4d \implies 4d = -10 \implies d = -2.5$$

Find the number of terms $n$ given the last term $u_n = -28$:
$$a + (n - 1)d = -28 \implies 32 - 2.5(n - 1) = -28$$
$$-2.5(n - 1) = -60 \implies n - 1 = 24 \implies n = 25$$

Calculate the sum of all $25$ terms using $S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a + l)$:
$$S_{25} = \frac{25}{2}(32 + (-28)) = \frac{25}{2}(4) = 50$$

Identify the parameters of the geometric progression for the 10 years from 2005 to 2014 inclusive ($n = 2014 - 2005 + 1 = 10$):
$$a = 2000$$
$$r = 1 + 0.025 = 1.025$$

Calculate the total allocation using the geometric series sum formula:
$$S_{10} = \frac{a(r^{10} - 1)}{r - 1} = \frac{2000(1.025^{10} - 1)}{1.025 - 1} = \frac{2000(1.280085 - 1)}{0.025}$$
$$= \frac{2000(0.280085)}{0.025} = 80000 \times 0.280085 \approx 22406.8 \approx 22400 \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
